notes.title: Spanish Translation Now Available! / ¡Traducción al español ya disponible!
notes.content:
[i][b]¡Hola a todo el mundo![/b]

¡El idoma español ya se encuentra disponible en la versión base del juego! ¡Muy amable y profesionalmente, Aarón Acencio tradujo el juego entero, la IU y los créditos! Cuando inicies el juego otra vez, se te pedirá que selecciones el idioma que prefieras, pero puedes cambiarlo en cualquier momento en el menú de idiomas, en ajustes.[/i]

Hello Everybody!

Spanish is now available in the base build! Aarón Acencio has very kindly and professionally translated the entire game, UI, and credits! You will now be prompted to select your language when you first boot the game up but can change anytime from the preferences menu as well.

I have also updated the version of Ren'Py that Queen Beast runs on as users were reporting issues with the previous issue on Steam Deck. If you want to play the game on Steam Deck, you no longer have to use an alternate branch!

[b]Previous save files may not be compatible with this version of the game[/b]

I have two solutions for people who are currently in the process of playing:
[list]
[*] The previous build of the game is available as a beta branch. You can access it by right clicking on the game in your library > Properties> Betas> OldBuild1.2. Your old saves will work on this branch :D
[*] As Queen Beast is a linear game, you can also Ctrl/Skip to the previous place you were at, by selecting "Skip Unread Text" in the preferences.
[/list]

I have also drawn some cute chibis for the menus ' v'!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050516/09676f387d9c4fc2e4cec39c341eb6e82539b4ce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050516/734ce6cc7b7c7a24855d44af7cb97d14a9ce0341.png[/img]

Thanks kindly and until next time

- Envelope

notes.title: January 5th Update - Queen Beast Build 1.22
notes.content:
**Update: apparently save files were breaking, so I have reverted to the previous until I can resolve the issue with older save files >_< really sorry!!!**

Hello everyone again!
I have pushed a small patch update that addresses the following:
[list]
[*] Updates the version of Ren'Py to a more recent version; this should address the freezing issues on the Steam Deck!
[*] Updated the Audio slider code since Ren'Py now has a master volume implemented by default
[/list]
Please let me know if you continue to have any issues or bugs and feel free to ask any questions on the forums!
I have uploaded the game's OST to a playlist on youtube here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLhLkqqmp13fwXtTcNKj5fv-q44hMDurMb]QB OST![/url]
Thank you everyone who has played or left a review so far >u<! We really appreciate everything.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050516/81bbe5cd1d57274224c4263ce16e0680462c61a9.png[/img]

notes.title: Build Update - Queen Beast 1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!

I have pushed a small update to the build that adds:

[list]
[*] 'Streamer Mode' in the settings menu - completely obscures all instances of partial nudity, 'buttocks', more egregious examples of cleavage, etc. 
[*] Revamped the modesty filter code so that it should update dynamically so you don't have to reload the scene
[*] Fixed an issue with the chapter numbering
[*] Fixed some small issues with the map
[/list]
Examples of the streamer mode:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050516/a7f7f66ab8207d0289de996d2a34bf4097e261e7.png[/img]

If you encounter any other bugs, please let us know via the steam forum or email so we can get it patched up as soon as possible =].

Thanks so much for all your reviews and feedback (even people who were lukewarm on the game!), every piece is invaluable to us >_< Thank you!!!

notes.title: Queen Beast releasing in 3 days~
notes.content:
Hello~
Just announcing that our little freeware visual novel will be released on the 5th of December! 
The trailer is now available too on our main page~

[previewyoutube=_RXjxf3RRyE;full][/previewyoutube]

Unfortunately, the level of mature content meant that Queen Beast will only be available in the adults only section of Steam. To clarify, eroge style pornographic scenes are not present, but there is significant enough nudity and sexual themes in the story that I would not have felt comfortable cutting for the sake of skirting the AO label. There is an in game toggle that minimally covers most frontal nudity if you'd prefer to avoid it, and you can follow our [url=https://twitter.com/envelope_dev]twitter account[/url] for more information if you are from a country that cannot access AO titles on Steam.

Anyway, I'm going to get back to bug squashing, thank you for taking the time to read ^^

- Scribbler
